name: What are common bathroom accessibility modifications?

mainEntity.name: What are common bathroom accessibility modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common bathroom accessibility modifications include installing grab bars near the toilet and in the shower/tub, converting tubs to walk-in showers with zero-threshold entry, raising toilet heights, and ensuring adequate clear floor space for maneuverability. Other modifications might involve widening doorways, adjusting sink heights for wheelchair access, and installing non-slip flooring. These changes aim to enhance safety and independence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common modifications include grab bars, walk-in showers, raised toilets, and ensuring clear floor space.
